title: astramem/atom@2
description: Canonical Memory Atom v2 (ADR-001 amendment, 2026-07-09). Breaking major bump from atom@1 — zero-customers window used to fix three warts in one cut rather than carry additive debt: (1) entities is now a typed object array instead of string[]; (2) provenance.repo is deleted (project is the single canonical field); (3) the 'personal' scope alias is dropped (private|team|org only). Shipped alongside atom.v1.schema.json for a time-boxed dual-read window on the cloud reader (see contracts/README.md 'Versioning rules' and the ADR-001 amendment) — atom@1 is NOT deleted by this change.

type.description: Registry-extensible, closed by default. Same 10-value union as atom@1 (ADR D4) — unaffected by the atom@2 cut: decision, fact, lesson, command, todo, note, event, preference, task_result, summary.

evidence.description: Receipts — never optional. Unchanged from atom@1; see contracts/README.md 'Evidence reconciliation'.

anyOf.description: Local v1 form: a short free-text excerpt supporting the atom.
ADR-001 canonical form: structured receipts pointing at source transcript spans.

provenance.description: Where this atom came from. atom@2 BREAKING CHANGE: 'repo' is deleted — 'project' is the single canonical field (cloud already collapses project_id ?? repo onto one WorkspaceProjectId column; a still-populated repo filter could return false negatives under atom@1). Writers that only had a repo value should send it as 'project'.

extractor.description: name@version of the extractor that produced this atom.

valid_to.description: Bitemporal valid-time end. null = currently valid.

scope.description: ADR-009 memory scope. atom@2 BREAKING CHANGE: the 'personal' alias (kept in atom@1 as a one-release dual-read accommodation, U7-local astramem-local#110, DEC-048, tracked as TODO(remove-personal-alias) astramem-local#115) is dropped. 'private' is the only low-rank value; new AND existing writers on atom@2 must emit private|team|org.

content_hash.description: sha256 hex digest — dedup + sync idempotency (ADR-003).

entities.description: atom@2 BREAKING CHANGE: typed entity objects instead of atom@1's flat string[]. The flat shape was lossy — astramem-local's own harness.ts:137 already re-synthesized a fake kind for every string, proving downstream consumers need kind. See ENTITY_KINDS (12-value registry) / ACTOR_KINDS in contracts/wire.ts.

kind.description: 12-value canonical entity-kind registry. Mirrors ENTITY_KINDS in contracts/wire.ts (kept in sync by tests/contracts/entity-kind-parity.test.ts).

subtype.description: Optional refinement, meaningful for actor-family kinds (see ACTOR_KINDS in contracts/wire.ts): human or AI agent.

valid_at.description: FEAT-453: bitemporal valid-time start for THIS entity link (fact-level, distinct from the atom's own valid_from). null = no stated fact-level start; resolves to the atom's own valid_from at query time.

invalid_at.description: FEAT-453: bitemporal valid-time end for THIS entity link. null = not known to have stopped being true.
